+package slices_test
+
+import (
+	"reflect"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/sitoo/auth/lib/slices"
+)
+
+func TestBatch(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		name      string
+		items     []int
+		batchSize int
+		want      [][]int
+	}{
+		{
+			name:      "even division",
+			items:     []int{1, 2, 3, 4},
+			batchSize: 2,
+			want:      [][]int{{1, 2}, {3, 4}},
+		},
+		{
+			name:      "remainder batch",
+			items:     []int{1, 2, 3, 4, 5},
+			batchSize: 2,
+			want:      [][]int{{1, 2}, {3, 4}, {5}},
+		},
+		{
+			name:      "batch size larger than items",
+			items:     []int{1, 2, 3},
+			batchSize: 10,
+			want:      [][]int{{1, 2, 3}},
+		},
+		{
+			name:      "batch size of one",
+			items:     []int{1, 2, 3},
+			batchSize: 1,
+			want:      [][]int{{1}, {2}, {3}},
+		},
+		{
+			name:      "empty items",
+			items:     []int{},
+			batchSize: 2,
+			want:      [][]int{},
+		},
+		{
+			name:      "nil items",
+			items:     nil,
+			batchSize: 2,
+			want:      [][]int{},
+		},
+		{
+			name:      "zero batch size",
+			items:     []int{1, 2, 3},
+			batchSize: 0,
+			want:      nil,
+		},
+		{
+			name:      "negative batch size",
+			items:     []int{1, 2, 3},
+			batchSize: -1,
+			want:      nil,
+		},
+	}
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			got := slices.Batch(tt.items, tt.batchSize)
+			if !reflect.DeepEqual(tt.want, got) {
+				t.Errorf("Batch() = %v, want %v", got, tt.want)
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}
